articles.summary: SR200 Product Brief Product / Astra Embedded Processors / Astra SR200 Series Introducing SR200 Read More Product / Astra Embedded Processors / Astra SR200 Series Defining a New Silicon Class for the AI-Native Edge Read More Product Overview The Synaptics Astra SR200 Series of AI-native MCUs delivers high-performance, low-power multimodal compute for wearables, connected cameras, and industrial vision and voice systems. Powered by the Synaptics Torq™ AI engine with Google Research’s Coral NPU™, the series provides 400 GOPS of AI inference alongside Arm® Cortex®-M85 and Cortex®-M52 cores. Its integrated vision, display, and audio pipelines support applications such as camera processing, rich user interfaces, wake-word detection, and voice processing. A multi-die system-in-package design combines compute, power management, and high-capacity memory to improve design efficiency and reduce system power and cost. With advanced security, broad connectivity, Zephyr RTOS support, and an open-source NPU compiler, SR200 MCUs enable a new class of edge and physical AI devices. Media MCU Efficiency. Read more Trusted by Industry Leaders “AI is quickly becoming the most important use case for edge devices, with workloads increasingly spanning always-on sensing and inference through to more demanding voice, vision and multi-media processing,” said Chris Bergey, EVP, Edge AI, Arm. “By bringing Arm Cortex-M85 and Cortex-M52 together for the first time, Synaptics is demonstrating how the Arm compute platform gives partners the flexibility to balance performance and efficiency across a growing range of intelligent edge devices.” Chris Bergey EVP of Edge AI "Next-generation AR wearables, including industrial smart glasses, demand real-time perception, contextual understanding, and seamless user interaction at the edge. By leveraging the integrated vision and audio architecture, extensible DRAM support, and high-efficiency Torq™ NPU of the Synaptics Astra® SR200 Series, we can execute complex scene understanding, low-latency overlay rendering, and continuous voice processing on a single, highly integrated SoC. As the CEO at Jorjin, I see a transformative opportunity to merge Synaptics' industry-changing SR200 platform with Jorjin's cutting-edge AI solutions to accelerate the commercialization of the next-generation products." Lerdah Wang CEO "Sonos products do more than play music; they connect every room, every source, every user, into one system, wirelessly. Astra's scalable edge compute, audio processing, and low power performance are the kind of capabilities that matter as we push what's possible in audio,"" said Kurt Preston, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Sonos. ""Delivering that requires partnership across every level of the organization, from joint development to production that scales with us." Kurt Preston Chief Supply Chain Officer “Synaptics has been a valued engineering partner as we explore the Astra® processor family, bringing strong expertise in both AI software and hardware capabilities. The Astra SR200 Series introduces an exciting approach to MCU design, with potential applications in AI-driven automation, intelligent edge devices, and industrial IoT. We look forward to exploring how this technology could enable new possibilities across our future product portfolio,” said Enco Liew, VP of Value Line Business Center at Accton Technology Corporation." Explore product SR80 Series High-performance Audio AI MCUs with ultra-low-power consumption enable intelligent, voice-driven experiences across consumer and enterprise IoT devices. Featuring an Arm® Cortex®-M33 MCU, Synaptics DSP cores, a dedicated NPU, Tensilica® HiFi 5 DSP, integrated CODEC, high-speed USB, advanced security, and turnkey AI algorithms including ENC, hybrid ANC, and speech recognition. Explore product Astra Machina™ Micro The Synaptics Astra Machina Micro developer kit enables rapid prototyping for the Synaptics SR100 Series of high-performance, context-aware, multimodal AI MCUs. The dev kit brings interfaces and IO ranging from qSPI for storage, M.2 for connectivity, digital mics for voice processing, and MIPI-CSI for multiple camera inputs. The SR100 series of MCUs - including SR110, SR105, and SR102 deliver AI-accelerated performance at all power levels in combination with ultra low-power multimodal sensing.
